ForwardGuidex — Third-party browser libraries (self-hosted, pinned)
===================================================================

These minified builds are vendored into app/js/vendor/ so the dashboard can run
with a strict Content-Security-Policy (script-src 'self') and make no external
network requests at runtime. Each file is pinned by version and its SHA-256 is
recorded in checksums.txt.
